title: Jazzy Syrian Potato Stew
description: A funky, creamy monsoon-inspired Syrian stew that blends diced potatoes with aromatic spices and a silky yogurt finish.

ingredients.name: Potato starch
ingredients.notes: mixed with 2 tbsp cold water to make slurry

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, sauté until translucent about five minutes.
Stir in diced potatoes and carrots, cook for three minutes.
Mix in tomato paste, cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking another minute to toast the spices.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for twenty minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Whisk potato starch slurry and stir it into the pot to thicken.
Remove the pot from heat and fold in plain yogurt, stirring until smooth and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, serve hot.
